description: United Kingdom undergraduate tuition fee caps for home (domestic) students. Fees are legally capped by government and publicly documented. England, Wales, Scotland, and Northern Ireland have different policies.
source: UK Parliament Research Briefing CBP-8151; OfS fee limit data
note: Tuition fees for home (UK-domiciled) undergraduate students. International student fees are unregulated and much higher. Scotland charges no fees to Scottish students. Amounts shown are annual fee caps/limits per academic year.

england.description: England - annual maximum fee for home undergraduates

policyHistory.note: University education free for all UK students; mandatory grants provided
First tuition fees introduced (Teaching and Higher Education Act 1998). Means-tested; £1,000 maximum
Variable fees up to £3,000 introduced (Higher Education Act 2004). Deferred payment via income-contingent loans
Fees trebled to £9,000 following Browne Review. Most universities charged maximum
Cap raised to £9,250 with Teaching Excellence Framework adjustments
Cap held at £9,250 (freeze maintained despite inflation)
First real-terms increase since 2017; announced by Labour government September 2024

scotland.description: Scotland - home (Scottish domiciled) undergraduates pay NO tuition fees; funded by Scottish Government via SAAS

policyHistory.note: Brief period of fees, same as England
Graduate Endowment replaced fees (£2,000 payable after graduation)
Scottish Parliament abolished upfront fees. Graduate Endowment applied.
Graduate Endowment abolished. Scottish students study FREE. Remains at £0 through 2025.

scotland.note: Scottish-domiciled students pay £0 in fees at Scottish universities. Non-Scottish UK students pay same as England rate.

wales.description: Wales - Welsh Government provides tuition fee grants to reduce student costs

policyHistory.note: Same as England
Same cap as England; Assembly Grant reduced effective cost
Fee cap at £9,000 but Welsh Government grant brought student contribution to ~£3,810
Welsh Government grant adjusted
Diamond Review 2018: means-tested grants replaced fee grants; net cost increased
Same cap as England at £9,250

northernIreland.description: Northern Ireland - kept lower fees than England after 2012

policyHistory.note: Same as England
Same as England cap
NI did not raise fees to £9,000; kept at lower level
Gradual increases; still well below England

international.description: International student fees - unregulated, set by each university
international.note: International undergraduate fees are unregulated. Typical ranges shown. Russell Group universities are at the higher end.

2024.note: Top medical/engineering courses at elite universities can exceed £40,000
